title_en: 4506 Army Corps of Engineers joined the tea party in Bugeok-mun village to strengthen community relations and introduced an app called “Emergency Time” to increase emergency notification channels.
summary_en: On November 27, 2569 at 11:00 a.m. the Special Operations Unit of the 45th Ranger Regiment led by Major General Samchai Varee, Commander of the Ranger Company No. 4506 and Civil Affairs Task Force headed off to meet and talk with local residents at the tea shop in Ban Buget Munin, Village No.4, Marbottak Village, Ra-ngae District, Narathiwat Province to inquire about their grievances.
